results.description: An array of schedule history results, one per variant.

schedule.description: The schedule definition in RFC 5545 (iCalendar) format.

next_run.description:
The next scheduled run time (RFC3339), or null if no future
run is scheduled.

schedule.description: The schedule definition in RFC 5545 (iCalendar) format.

RRuleSet.description: RFC 5545 recurrence rule components for a schedule.

dtstart.description:
The DTSTART component specifying when the schedule begins,
including timezone information.

rrules.description: An array of RRULE components defining the recurrence pattern.

until.description: The UNTIL component specifying when the schedule ends, if applicable.

change_type.description: The type of change that was made to the schedule.

change_time.description: The timestamp (RFC3339) when this change was made.

user.description: The user who made this change, or null if the user has been deleted.

new_schedule.description:
The schedule state after this change, or null if the schedule
was deleted.

created_time.description:
The timestamp (RFC3339) indicating when the user was created in
the Posit Connect server.

updated_time.description:
The timestamp (RFC3339) indicating when information about this
user was last updated in the Posit Connect server.

active_time.description:
The timestamp (RFC3339) indicating approximately when the user
was last active. Highly active users only receive periodic updates.

confirmed.description:
When `false`, the created user must confirm their account through
an email. This feature is unique to password authentication.

locked.description: Whether or not the user is locked.

external_id.description:
The unique identifier for this user from the authentication
provider, when available.

guid.description:
The user's GUID, or unique identifier, in UUID
[RFC4122](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4122)
format

variant_key.description: The unique key identifying this variant.

current_schedule.description:
The current active schedule for this variant, or null if no
schedule exists.

history.description:
A list of schedule change history entries, ordered by change time
(most recent first). Limited to the 100 most recent entries.

total_count.description:
The total number of history entries for this variant. This may be
larger than the number of entries in the `history` array, which is
limited to 100 entries.
